items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: And I met Strayhorn; he had just joined. And Ray Nance...

ctx.x: Because they were gonna go someplace after work and play, and they'd say, "How about going down to the Green Lantern or the so-and-so?" I'd say, "Well, I'm gonna be there, and I want to play for you." And I played for Joe Thomas, I wound up... They were there for about three days, and I played for him every night. I played for Dan Grissom while he was singing. And I learned all their arrangements.

And then Ellington came for two weeks, and that's when I got firmly in there with Ben, you know -- he and I just turned into brothers right there. That was all day and all night, just the two of us playing. We'd hook up with a drummer or a bass player or somethin' like that, and play. And I played a lot with Jimmy Blanton. And I met Strayhorn; he had just joined. And Ray Nance...
